spec.title: Bolek quality
spec.description: Conversation Analyzer (§8.8): aggregates only, read every morning.

target.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP(day), INTERVAL IFNULL(hour, 0) HOUR) AS time,
       IF(kind IN ('JUDGE', 'PARALLEL_RUN_END'), CONCAT('judge ', IFNULL(judge_version, '')), CONCAT(source, ' · ', kind))
         AS text,
       IF(kind IN ('JUDGE', 'PARALLEL_RUN_END'), 'judge', 'change') AS tags
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_change_events` WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day))

SELECT DISTINCT TIMESTAMP(day) AS time, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(day, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS timeEnd, 'log incomplete' AS text
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily` WHERE incomplete AND metric = 'VOLUME' AND channel = 'ALL' AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day))

SELECT DISTINCT TIMESTAMP(day) AS time, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(day, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS timeEnd, 'weekend' AS text
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily` WHERE day_kind = 'WEEKEND' AND metric = 'VOLUME' AND channel = 'ALL' AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day))

panels.title: 1. Is the pipeline healthy?  (last complete day, all departments; per run below)
Last complete day, all departments (Resumed: all channels)
panels.description: Coverage: assessed or too large over the log's eligible turns. Resumed and continued: segments resumed after an idle close whose first turn continues the conversation; if high, keep segments open longer (§5).

targets.rawSql:
WITH last AS (SELECT MAX(day) AS day FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily` WHERE metric = 'VOLUME'),
d AS (SELECT metric, channel, value, incomplete FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily`, last
      WHERE `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily`.day = last.day AND slice_kind = 'ALL' AND channel IN ('${channel}', 'ALL'))
SELECT
  100 * MAX(IF(metric = 'COVERAGE' AND channel = '${channel}', value, NULL)) AS `Coverage`,
  MAX(IF(metric = 'MISSED_COUNT' AND channel = '${channel}', value, NULL)) AS `Missed`,
  MAX(IF(metric = 'OLDEST_WAITING_MINUTES', value, NULL)) AS `Oldest waiting`,
  100 * MAX(IF(metric = 'TOO_LARGE_SHARE' AND channel = '${channel}', value, NULL)) AS `Too large`,
  IF(LOGICAL_OR(incomplete) OR SUM(IF(metric = 'LOG_GAP_HOURS' AND channel = 'ALL', value, 0)) > 0, 0, 1)
    AS `Log complete`,
  100 * MAX(IF(metric = 'RESUMED_WITHOUT_TEXT', value, NULL)) AS `Resumed without text`,
  100 * MAX(IF(metric = 'RESUMED_AND_CONTINUED', value, NULL)) AS `Resumed and continued`
FROM d

panels.title: Coverage per run (assessor, hourly)
panels.description: Per run; a failed run drops to the floor of the axis.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP(day), INTERVAL hour HOUR) AS time, coverage AS `coverage`
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_pipeline_health` WHERE kind = 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day)) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Runs with a check fired
panels.description: May be empty: no run fired a pipeline check.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP(day), INTERVAL hour HOUR) AS run, run_status AS status, eligible, missed,
       ROUND(oldest_waiting_minutes) AS oldest_waiting_min, ARRAY_TO_STRING(checks_fired, ', ') AS checks
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_pipeline_health` WHERE kind = 'RUN' AND ARRAY_LENGTH(checks_fired) > 0 AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day))
ORDER BY run DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Open anomalies (and acknowledged in the last 14 days)
panels.description: May be empty: nothing unusual, or every anomaly was acknowledged more than 14 days ago.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT REPLACE(a.metric, 'FAILURE_RATE_', 'failure rate · ') AS metric, a.channel, a.kind, a.opened_day AS since, ROUND(a.value * 100, 1) AS value_pct,
       ROUND(a.reference_value * 100, 1) AS reference_pct,
       CONCAT(ROUND(a.band_low * 100, 1), ' – ', ROUND(a.band_high * 100, 1)) AS band_pct,
       IF(a.explained, (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(e.kind, ' ', CAST(e.day AS STRING)), ', ')
                        FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_change_events` e WHERE e.event_id IN UNNEST(a.change_events)), 'unexplained')
         AS change_events_before,
       a.state, a.acknowledged_day
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_anomalies` a
WHERE a.state = 'OPEN' OR a.acknowledged_day >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY)
ORDER BY a.state DESC, a.opened_day DESC

panels.title: AQR per day, with 7-day average and reference band
panels.description: If raw and standardized move apart, the question mix changed, not quality. The band is the 28 days before ± 3 standard deviations (§8.7).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT day, MAX(IF(metric = 'AQR_STANDARDIZED', value, NULL)) AS std, MAX(IF(metric = 'AQR_RAW', value, NULL)) AS raw
  FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily` WHERE metric IN ('AQR_STANDARDIZED', 'AQR_RAW') AND channel = '${channel}' AND slice_kind = IF('${department}' = 'ALL', 'ALL', 'DEPARTMENT') AND slice_value = '${department}' AND ('${day_kind}' = 'ALL' OR day_kind = '${day_kind}') AND (n_turns IS NULL OR n_turns >= 20)
  GROUP BY day)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(day) AS time, std AS `AQR standardized`, raw AS `AQR raw`,
       AVG(std) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `7-day average`,
       AVG(std) OVER w - 3 * STDDEV(std) OVER w AS `reference low`,
       AVG(std) OVER w + 3 * STDDEV(std) OVER w AS `reference high`
FROM d WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 28 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Last complete day
panels.description: Contradicted: turns with a HIGH contradicted claim on the last complete day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT day, metric, value FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily`
           WHERE metric IN ('AQR_STANDARDIZED', 'CONTRADICTED_COUNT') AND channel = '${channel}' AND slice_kind = IF('${department}' = 'ALL', 'ALL', 'DEPARTMENT') AND slice_value = '${department}' AND ('${day_kind}' = 'ALL' OR day_kind = '${day_kind}')),
last AS (SELECT MAX(day) AS day FROM d)
SELECT ROUND(100 * MAX(IF(d.day = last.day AND metric = 'AQR_STANDARDIZED', value, NULL)), 1) AS `AQR`,
       ROUND(100 * (MAX(IF(d.day = last.day AND metric = 'AQR_STANDARDIZED', value, NULL))
             - AVG(IF(d.day < last.day AND d.day >= DATE_SUB(last.day, INTERVAL 28 DAY)
                      AND metric = 'AQR_STANDARDIZED', value, NULL))), 1) AS `vs 28-day ref. (pt)`,
       MAX(IF(d.day = last.day AND metric = 'CONTRADICTED_COUNT', value, NULL)) AS `Contradicted`
FROM d, last

panels.title: Not verifiable share and evidence mix (knowledge questions)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP(day) AS time,
       MAX(IF(metric = 'EVIDENCE_OWN_SHARE', value, NULL)) AS `own references`,
       MAX(IF(metric = 'EVIDENCE_EARLIER_SHARE', value, NULL)) AS `earlier references`,
       MAX(IF(metric = 'EVIDENCE_NONE_SHARE', value, NULL)) AS `no evidence`,
       MAX(IF(metric = 'NOT_VERIFIABLE_SHARE', value, NULL)) AS `not verifiable`
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily`
WHERE metric IN ('EVIDENCE_OWN_SHARE', 'EVIDENCE_EARLIER_SHARE', 'EVIDENCE_NONE_SHARE', 'NOT_VERIFIABLE_SHARE') AND channel = '${channel}' AND slice_kind = IF('${department}' = 'ALL', 'ALL', 'DEPARTMENT') AND slice_value = '${department}' AND ('${day_kind}' = 'ALL' OR day_kind = '${day_kind}') AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day)) AND (n_turns IS NULL OR n_turns >= 20)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Failure rates by primary failure (share of assessed turns)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP(day) AS time, REPLACE(metric, 'FAILURE_RATE_', '') AS metric, value
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily` WHERE STARTS_WITH(metric, 'FAILURE_RATE_') AND channel = '${channel}' AND slice_kind = IF('${department}' = 'ALL', 'ALL', 'DEPARTMENT') AND slice_value = '${department}' AND ('${day_kind}' = 'ALL' OR day_kind = '${day_kind}') AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day)) AND n_turns >= 20
ORDER BY time

SELECT TIMESTAMP(day) AS time,
       MAX(IF(metric = 'CONTRADICTED_SHARE', value, NULL)) AS `contradicted (of knowledge turns)`,
       MAX(IF(metric = 'UNSUPPORTED_SHARE', value, NULL)) AS `unsupported (of claim spans)`,
       MAX(IF(metric = 'CONTRADICTED_COUNT', value, NULL)) AS `contradicted turns`
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily`
WHERE metric IN ('CONTRADICTED_SHARE', 'UNSUPPORTED_SHARE', 'CONTRADICTED_COUNT') AND channel = '${channel}' AND slice_kind = IF('${department}' = 'ALL', 'ALL', 'DEPARTMENT') AND slice_value = '${department}' AND ('${day_kind}' = 'ALL' OR day_kind = '${day_kind}') AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day)) AND (n_turns IS NULL OR n_turns >= 20)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY time

panels.title: AQR by topic × week
panels.description: Weekly AQR (raw) per topic; slices under 20 turns are merged by the daily job.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP(DATE_TRUNC(day, WEEK(MONDAY))) AS time, slice_value AS metric,
       SUM(numerator) / SUM(denominator) AS value
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily` WHERE metric = 'AQR_RAW' AND slice_kind = 'TOPIC' AND channel = '${channel}' AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day))
  AND ('${day_kind}' = 'ALL' OR day_kind = '${day_kind}')
GROUP BY time, metric HAVING SUM(n_turns) >= 20 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Question mix by intent
panels.description: Share of assessed turns per intent, per day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP(day) AS time, slice_value AS metric, n_turns AS value
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily` WHERE metric = 'AQR_RAW' AND slice_kind = 'INTENT' AND channel = '${channel}' AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day))
  AND ('${day_kind}' = 'ALL' OR day_kind = '${day_kind}')
ORDER BY time

panels.title: AQR by department family and data store family (selected period)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CONCAT(IF(slice_kind = 'DEPARTMENT', 'department · ', 'data store · '), slice_value) AS family,
       SUM(numerator) / SUM(denominator) AS AQR
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily` WHERE metric = 'AQR_RAW' AND slice_kind IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'DATA_STORE_FAMILY') AND channel = '${channel}' AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day))
  AND ('${day_kind}' = 'ALL' OR day_kind = '${day_kind}')
GROUP BY slice_kind, slice_value HAVING SUM(n_turns) >= 20 ORDER BY slice_kind DESC, AQR DESC

SELECT TIMESTAMP(day) AS time, value AS `negative reactions`
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily`
WHERE metric = 'NEGATIVE_REACTION_RATE' AND channel = '${channel}' AND slice_kind = IF('${department}' = 'ALL', 'ALL', 'DEPARTMENT') AND slice_value = '${department}' AND ('${day_kind}' = 'ALL' OR day_kind = '${day_kind}') AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day)) AND (n_turns IS NULL OR n_turns >= 20) 
ORDER BY time

SELECT TIMESTAMP(day) AS time,
       MAX(IF(metric = 'DISLIKE_COUNT', value, NULL)) AS `dislikes`,
       MAX(IF(metric = 'DISLIKE_RATE', value, NULL)) AS `dislike rate`
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily`
WHERE metric IN ('DISLIKE_COUNT', 'DISLIKE_RATE') AND channel = '${channel}' AND slice_kind = 'ALL' AND ('${day_kind}' = 'ALL' OR day_kind = '${day_kind}') AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day)) AND (n_turns IS NULL OR n_turns >= 20)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Volume and active users
panels.description: Active users come from Google's engine metrics, about 3 days late, for all channels together.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP(day) AS time,
       MAX(IF(metric = 'VOLUME', value, NULL)) AS `turns`,
       MAX(IF(metric = 'ACTIVE_USERS', value, NULL)) AS `active users`
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_metrics_daily`
WHERE metric IN ('VOLUME', 'ACTIVE_USERS') AND slice_kind = 'ALL' AND ((metric = 'VOLUME' AND channel = '${channel}') OR (metric = 'ACTIVE_USERS' AND channel = 'ALL')) AND ('${day_kind}' = 'ALL' OR day_kind = '${day_kind}') AND $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(day)) AND (n_turns IS NULL OR n_turns >= 20)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY time

panels.title: 7. What to fix, and did it help?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT `rank`, primary_failure, owner, topic, doc_id, n_turns, n_high, weighted, ROUND(trend * 100) AS trend_pct
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_problem_clusters` WHERE week = (SELECT MAX(week) FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_problem_clusters`)
ORDER BY `rank` LIMIT 10

panels.title: Change events with release impact (AQR standardized)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.day, e.kind, e.source, r.verdict, ROUND(r.diff * 100, 1) AS diff_pt, ROUND(r.se * 100, 1) AS se_pt,
       r.gate_verdict
FROM `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_change_events` e
LEFT JOIN `bolek_quality_metrics.quality_release_impact` r ON r.event_id = e.event_id AND r.metric = 'AQR_STANDARDIZED' AND r.channel = 'ALL'
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(e.day)) ORDER BY e.day DESC
